author: GamingBolt
description:
All in all, Echoes of Aincrad does succeed in portraying the expansive VR world away from Kirito and Asuna, but only just. It gives enough options to forge your own creation, although the immersion in your avatar’s journey would be better served if they talked to their companions. 

Sadly, the game’s biggest struggles - its pacing, mechanical friction, and repetition - far outweigh the positives that can be gleaned out of buildcrafting and atmosphere design. For those reasons, Echoes of Aincrad is a tough sell, even if you’ve the patience of a veteran.
title: Sword Art Online: Echoes of Aincrad Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
There’s been chatter from a known industry insider who claims to know more about the plans for Resident Evil expansions in the next few years. Well, we checked it all out, and decided to just let our imaginations think about what could be the franchise’s future if the rumors were true. 

It was a train of thought with a lot of interesting stops as it turns out, and we’re happy to take you on a journey that could very well point us all to what’s next for a horror franchise we’ve loved for many years. Hop in as we explore how the developer is using expansions to give itself more breathing room while deciding what comes next for one of its biggest franchises.
title: Resident Evil’s DLC Future Could Be BIGGER Than Anyone Expected

author: GamingBolt
description:
What defines a great remake? Is it modernised mechanics, streamlined narrative pacing, or overhauled graphics? Increasingly, the best remakes do all of those things, but they’re also doing something less tangible: preserving intent. 

Back in 2001, Halo: Combat Evolved wasn’t just a technological marvel, nor is it remembered solely as an FPS seachange. It represented a design philosophy built around simplicity and atmosphere, and Halo: Campaign Evolved appears to understand this completely. Halo Studios is rebuilding one of gaming’s most defining shooters, yes, but they’re not replacing what made it special in the first place. Instead, they’re making sure it's as evocative as you remember.
title: Why Halo Campaign Evolved Is Shaping Up To Be One of the Biggest Games of 2026
